SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission critical positions (pun intended).

In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm. We work in teams and focus on collaboration yet require a high degree of autonomy.

So while you are not expected to simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.
Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:
Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker
Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates
Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking
Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews
Give tours to candidates before their onsite interview – this is a chance to showcase all the exciting things going on at SpaceX
Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates
Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the HR onboarding process including initiating background checks, completing reference checks, negotiating offer packages including extending offer letters, and issuing new hire paperwork – you’ll have plenty of support from the HR, benefits, and compensation departments to make this process as seamless as possible
Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience. Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates. No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals to help advance the mission to Mars!

5+ years of technical recruiting experience
Experience recruiting electrical, mechanical, manufacturing and/or aerospace engineers
Experience with high volume recruiting
Experience with full life cycle recruiting (screening candidates, facilitating interviews and extending offers)
Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their respective fields
Demonstrated expertise in non-standard recruiting methods: cold calling candidates and companies, organizing and executing ad hoc networking events, identifying industry experts and finding unique methods to engage with them, creating unique targeted sourcing campaigns, etc.
Comfortable interfacing directly with hiring managers including director and VP level technical leaders
Ability to build strong relationships with both hiring managers and candidates
Ability to accurately present but not oversell candidates to client groups; influence decisions by acting as the subject matter expert on talent but avoid dictating client decisions
Ability to multi-task and operate with little direction while still being an active team member

Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed

Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.
Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.
Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like .

This is the hire that lets us keep the bar high while we scale hard.
Most of the people we want don't apply to job posts, and the roles we most need to fill are the hardest ones - mechanical, mechatronics, electronics, controls and perception engineers, plus genuinely unusual roles that don't have a playbook. You'll own those hires end to end: finding people in unlikely places, running them through the process, reading them accurately, and closing them.
We've deliberately kept this in-house rather than handing it to an agency, because the hard part isn't matching a CV to a job spec; it's judgment about people and protecting our culture as we grow, and you can't outsource that. You'll work directly with our founders and hiring managers, operate with real autonomy, and be trusted to make the call on who clears the bar.
You'll join Dom , who leads recruiting, as a senior partner on the team, not a pair of hands to hand reqs to, but someone who owns their roles, raises how we hire, and makes the whole machine better.

Own full-cycle hiring for our hardest and most unusual roles: sourcing, assessing, and closing, end to end
Find and engage talent in unlikely places: personal websites, GitHub, citations, Discord, Substack, YouTube, competitions; you might even vibecode your own sourcing tool, whatever works
Read people accurately: assess for raw ability, drive, judgment and culture fit, not just a keyword match on their CV. This is the part that matters most
Partner with founders and hiring managers to deeply understand each role and what "great" actually looks like here
Give candidates an outstanding experience: anticipate their needs, build genuine rapport, and be the person in their corner all the way to signed
Raise the bar on how we hire: fix broken process, sharpen our assessment, decide where an external partner is worth it and where it isn't, and make the team better around you

You've run full-cycle hiring for tough-to-fill technical roles (hardware, deep tech, or otherwise non-standard) and closed people who had other options
You have genuinely high standards. You'd rather tell a hiring manager a search is taking longer than put a mediocre candidate in front of them, and you can tell the difference
You're an excellent judge of people: you can read drive, rawness and culture fit in a conversation, and you protect the bar even under pressure to just fill the seat
Founders and hiring managers trust you quickly. You earn credibility through competence and consistently doing what you said you would
Genuine interest in technology: you don't need to be an engineer, but you can hold a semi-technical conversation about what someone builds and why it matters
Strong written and verbal communication: your outreach gets replies because it's human, specific and thoughtful, and you know how to stand out on a first call
You take full ownership and operate well in ambiguity. We're scaling fast, priorities shift, process evolves, and you fix what isn't working yourself rather than wait to be told
You've done this inside a VC-backed startup or scale-up, and you're comfortable being embedded and close to the work, not running a volume desk from arm's length

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have the right to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to opt out of AI-assisted review, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision.

Tu utiliseras les données scientifiques de tes évaluations comme un levier pour convaincre tes clients de miser sur le potentiel, tout en menant les négociations (salariales, conditions) d'une main de maître.

## About Our Client ##
Für eine etablierte, interdisziplinäre Gesundheitsorganisation in der Schweiz, die in einem dynamischen und regulierten Umfeld tätig ist, suchen wir eine/n Lead HR Business Partnering (m/w/d). Die Organisation zeichnet sich durch Wachstum, laufende Transformationen sowie einen starken Fokus auf Qualität, Compliance und Mitarbeitende aus.
## Job Description ##
Der Lead HR Business Partner ist der führende HR-Partner für die deutschsprachige Region der Schweiz und unterstützt das Unternehmenswachstum über mehrere Portfoliogesellschaften hinweg. Die Rolle verbindet strategische HR-Führung mit einer ausgeprägten Nähe zum operativen Geschäft und stellt sicher, dass HR-Initiativen wirksam umgesetzt werden.

Sie führt ein Team von HR Business Partnern und vereint strategische HR-Beratung, Organisationsentwicklung sowie operative HR-Führung. Darüber hinaus treibt sie die Integration von Akquisitionen, organisatorische Veränderungen und People-Initiativen im Einklang mit der unternehmensweiten HR-Strategie voran.
**Zu den Hauptaufgaben gehören:**
1. **Strategisches HR Business Partnering**
* Hauptansprechpartner für das regionale Management und Beratung der Führungskräfte in Organisationsentwicklung, Leadership und Change Management.
* Leitet aus Geschäftsstrategien HR-Initiativen ab und treibt deren Umsetzung zur Förderung von Wachstum, Performance und Integration voran.
* Mitarbeit an strategischen HR-Projekten.
* Bearbeitet komplexe arbeitsrechtliche Fragestellungen und stellt die Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher sowie Compliance-Vorgaben sicher.
1. **Organisationsentwicklung & Integration**
* Verantwortet die HR-Integration neuer Unternehmen sowie die Umsetzung von Organisations- und Veränderungsinitiativen.
* Unterstützt Führungskräfte in den Bereichen Organisationsdesign, Talent- und Performance-Management sowie Mitarbeiterbindung.
* Fördert Talent- und Nachfolgeplanung auf regionaler Ebene.
1. **Weiterentwicklung des HR-Betriebsmodells**
* Treibt die Umsetzung des HR-Betriebsmodells voran und stärkt die Zusammenarbeit zwischen HR Business Partnern, Shared Services und dem Business.
* Entwickelt das HRBP-Team zu einem strategischen Business-Partnering-Modell weiter.
1. **Führung des HR-Teams**
* Führt, coacht und entwickelt das regionale Team der HR Business Partner.
* Fördert einen einheitlichen HR-Ansatz sowie den Austausch von Best Practices über die Region hinweg.
1. **Zusammenarbeit mit HR Operations**
* Gewährleistet eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit dem HR Shared Service Center innerhalb des Verantwortungsbereichs
* Sicherstellung der Payroll-Prozesse bis voraussichtlich Frühjahr 2027 im Rahmen der Übergangsphase bis zur vollständigen Übergabe an das Shared Service Center, inklusive Verantwortung für die Lohnverarbeitung und den Jahresabschluss 2026 für einen der Standorte.
## The Successful Applicant ##
**Hintergrund und Erfahrung**
* Weiterbildung im Bereich HR (HR Fachausweis, Payroll Spezialist, CAS, MAS, Personalleiter) und/oder HR Studium
* Mehrjährige fundierte hands-on-Erfahrung im Schweizer HR-Umfeld als HR Generalist, HR Manager oder Head of HR, mit breitem Verständnis für operative und strategische HR-Themen inklusiv Payroll
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts und der HR-Praxis.
* HR-Führungserfahrung in einer komplexen Organisation mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten.
* Erfahrung in Organisationsentwicklung, Change Management sowie Unternehmens- und Kulturintegration.
* Fähigkeit, strategische HR-Themen pragmatisch und umsetzungsstark mit operativen Anforderungen zu verbinden.
* Führungserfahrung in einer regulierten, dienstleistungsorientierten Branche, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in den Life Sciences.
* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (Region Deutschschweiz) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
**Persönliche Eigenschaften**
* Strategische und zugleich hands-on orientierte Führungspersönlichkeit.
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beziehungskompetenz mit der Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu verbinden.
* Souveränes Auftreten in einem dynamischen und sich wandelnden Umfeld.
* Pragmatisch, lösungsorientiert und entscheidungsstark.
* Vertrauenswürdige Persönlichkeit mit hoher Glaubwürdigkeit auf allen Organisationsebenen.
* Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von Menschen, den Aufbau leistungsfähiger Organisationen und die Schaffung nachhaltiger Werte.
## What's on Offer ##
* Die Möglichkeit, nachhaltige Wirkung zu erzielen und die Weiterentwicklung der HR-Organisation aktiv mitzugestalten.
* Ein professionelles und kollegiales Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung, Fachkompetenz und Engagement fördert.
* Langfristige Entwicklungs- und Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen und wachsenden Gesundheitsumfeld.

Recruiting Coordinator
Firmenbeschreibung
Unser Beruf und unsere Leidenschaft «HR\-Management».
Als erfolgreiches zertifiziertes Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen mit 47 Filialen und über 250 Mitarbeitenden in der Schweiz, pflegt die Flexsis AG seit 1997 mit ihren spezialisierten Divisionen zu einer Vielzahl von Unternehmen und KandidatInnen eine partnerschaftliche Kooperation in den Bereichen Personalverleih / Contracting und Dauerstellen.
Für unseren Mandanten mit Sitz in Zürich\-Oerlikon, ein international tätiges Unternehmen aus der Industrie, suchen wir für einen langfristigen temporären Einsatz eine durchsetzungsfähige Fachkraft als
Recruiting CoordinatorJobbeschreibung
Wir suchen einen eigenverantwortlichen und detailorientierten Recruiting Coordinator (auf Vertragsbasis), der als operativer Motor unseres Talent\-Acquisition\-Prozesses fungiert.
In dieser Rolle verantworten Sie den gesamten Ablauf der Terminplanung sowie das Candidate\-Experience\-Management für unsere wachsenden Teams in den Bereichen Engineering, KI und Operations. Dabei beschränken Sie sich nicht auf die reine Kalenderverwaltung; Sie stellen einen reibungslosen Ablauf des Einstellungsprozesses sicher, sorgen für eine positive Candidate Experience und unterstützen Hiring Manager bei der Koordination komplexer, mehrstufiger Auswahlgespräche.
Eigenständige Planung und Koordination mehrstufiger Interview\-Prozesse (technische Vorab\-Checks, vertiefende Fachgespräche, Präsentationen vor Gremien sowie On\-Site\-Interviewrunden) unter Berücksichtigung verschiedener Zeitzonen und der vollen Terminkalender der Engineering\-Teams.
Engagierte Betreuung der Kandidaten als zentraler Ansprechpartner während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses; Sicherstellung, dass sich die Kandidaten in jeder Phase willkommen, gut informiert und optimal vorbereitet fühlen.
Betreuung der Kandidaten vor Ort in unserem Büro \- von der Raumkoordination und dem Empfang der Gäste über die Vorbereitung der Präsentationsbereiche bis hin zur Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Ablaufs.
Gewährleistung einer präzisen Datenpflege im Bewerbermanagementsystem (ATS), Nachverfolgung des Kandidatenstatus, Aktualisierung von Gesprächsnotizen sowie Sicherstellung zeitnaher Rückmeldungen durch die Interview\-Gremien.
Übernahme der operativen und logistischen Organisation von Karrieremessen, Recruiting\-Events an Hochschulen (ETH Zürich) sowie Employer\-Branding\-Initiativen, einschließlich der Steuerung von Dienstleisterbeziehungen und der Logistik vor Ort.
Identifikation von Engpässen bei der Terminplanung, der Verfügbarkeit von Interview\-Panels oder den Feedback\-Schleifen für Kandidaten sowie proaktive Unterbreitung von Verbesserungsvorschlägen zur Beschleunigung des Einstellungsprozesses.
Gesuchtes Profil
Erfahrung in der Bewältigung komplexer Terminplanungen \- auch bei hohem Arbeitsaufkommen, engen Fristen und über verschiedene Zeitzonen hinweg.
Hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Initiative. Sie warten nicht auf Anweisungen. Wenn Sie Engpässe bei der Terminierung, fehlende Feedback\-Schleifen oder Terminkonflikte bemerken, ergreifen Sie proaktiv Maßnahmen zur Lösung.
Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeit und freundliches Auftreten. Sie kommunizieren schriftlich wie mündlich äußerst professionell, empathisch und klar.

## Firmenbeschreibung ##
dasteam ag - weil erfolgreiche Vermittlung mit echtem Teamgeist beginnt.
Wir gehören zu den Top 5 Stellenvermittlern der Schweiz - doch was uns wirklich auszeichnet, ist etwas anderes: der Mensch im Mittelpunkt. Als Familienunternehmen denken wir langfristig, handeln verbindlich und pflegen echte Beziehungen - innerhalb unseres Teams genauso wie mit unseren Kunden und Kandidaten.

Seit fast 40 Jahren bringen wir erfolgreich Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen und haben uns zu einem der führenden Personaldienstleister der Schweiz entwickelt. Mit 27 Niederlassungen in der Schweiz und im Fürstentum Liechtenstein sind wir regional stark verankert und gleichzeitig national bestens vernetzt.
Was uns besonders macht
Bei uns ist Teamwork nicht nur ein Schlagwort - es ist gelebte Realität: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und verfolgen alle das gleiche Ziel - die beste Lösung für Menschen und Unternehmen zu finden. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von:
* Kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hoher Flexibilität
* Vertrauen, Respekt und echter Wertschätzung
* Unternehmerischem Denken mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
* Leidenschaft für Menschen und ihre Karrieren
Arbeiten bei dasteam ag - mehr als nur ein Job
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
Als Personalberater:in bist du mitten im Geschehen: Du bringst Menschen und Unternehmen effizient zusammen - schnell, treffsicher und zielorientiert. Dein Alltag ist aktiv, kommunikativ und stark ergebnisfokussiert.
Du startest mit einem klaren Fokus: Welche Kunden brauchen dringend Personal? Wo fehlen Fachkräfte? Du analysierst Anforderungen im Detail und reagierst rasch - oft zählt jede Stunde.
Ein grosser Teil deiner Arbeit spielt sich am Telefon ab: Du gewinnst neue Kunden, betreust bestehende Kontakte und führst Gespräche mit Kandidaten. Du klärst Verfügbarkeiten, prüfst Qualifikationen und koordinierst Interviews - im Büro oder direkt vor Ort.
Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturierst deinen Tag selbst. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in Resultaten: schnelle, passgenaue Besetzungen und echter Mehrwert für deine Kunden.
Zudem bist du viel unterwegs: Du besuchst Kunden, baust Beziehungen aus und pflegst dein Netzwerk aktiv - sei es bei Terminen, Mittagessen oder Events.
Du bist Drehscheibe, Berater:in und Verkäufer:in zugleich, handelst unternehmerisch und bleibst auch in hektischen Momenten fokussiert.
Kurz gesagt: Du gestaltest deinen Erfolg selbst - mit viel Eigenverantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und einem dynamischen Alltag.
## Wir erwarten ##
Du suchst keinen ruhigen Bürojob, sondern ein Umfeld, in dem du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst? Perfekt - denn hier zählt deine Persönlichkeit mehr als dein Lebenslauf.
* Du hast Drive, Ehrgeiz und willst Resultate sehen - Abschlüsse, Besetzungen, Erfolg
* Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent (!) und hast keine Scheu vor dem Telefon - im Gegenteil: du blühst im Austausch mit Menschen auf
* Du verfügst über eine klare Verkaufsmentalität und denkst lösungs- und ergebnisorientiert
* Du arbeitest selbständig, strukturiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für deinen eigenen Erfolg
* Du bist schnell im Kopf und entscheidungsfreudig - du erkennst Chancen und handelst sofort
* Du bleibst dran, auch wenn-s mal schwierig wird - Rückschläge motivieren dich eher, als dass sie dich bremsen
* Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und kannst Vertrauen aufbauen sowie Beziehungen langfristig pflegen
* Du bist bodenständig, flexibel und packst mit an - genau das schätzen unsere Kunden und Mitarbeitenden
Kurz gesagt: Du bist Macher:in, Netzwerker:in und Verkäufer:in in einer Person - und hast richtig Lust, etwas aufzubauen und zu bewegen.
## Wir bieten ##
Bei uns findest du nicht einfach einen Job - sondern eine Plattform, auf der du erfolgreich sein kannst. Wir geben dir die richtigen Tools, ein starkes Umfeld und attraktive Rahmenbedingungen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.
* Bestehendes Kundenportfolio: Du startest nicht bei null, sondern übernimmst ein gewachsenes Netzwerk mit echtem Potenzial
* Firmenfahrzeug: Für deine Kundenbesuche stellen wir dir ein Fahrzeug zur Verfügung - flexibel und unkompliziert
* Überdurchschnittliche Verdienstmöglichkeiten: Dein Einsatz zahlt sich aus - mit einem attraktiven und transparenten Provisionsmodell, das Leistung direkt belohnt
* 5 Wochen Ferien: Erholung ist wichtig - damit du langfristig auf Top-Level performen kannst
* Starkes Team: Dich erwartet ein offenes, unterstützendes und motiviertes Umfeld, in dem man sich gegenseitig pusht und gemeinsam Erfolge feiert
* Flache Hierarchien & Du-Kultur: Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Kommunikation und ein unkompliziertes Miteinander auf Augenhöhe
* Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze und eine Infrastruktur, die dich in deinem Alltag optimal unterstützt
* Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Halbtax-Abo, Beteiligung an deinem Fitness-Abo, eine überdurchschnittliche Pensionskassenlösung sowie zusätzliche Vergünstigungen wie Flottenrabatte
Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung gesehen, honoriert und gefördert wird - und in dem du dir mit Engagement und Freude an der Arbeit wirklich etwas aufbauen kannst.

Rejoignez Sigmalis Talent Services et participez au développement d-un groupe suisse à taille humaine, spécialisé dans les métiers de l-informatique.
Le groupe Sigmalis
Présent en Suisse romande depuis 2007, Sigmalis réunit aujourd-hui deux structures complémentaires autour d-une même ambition : accompagner durablement les entreprises dans leurs projets informatiques.
Sigmalis, ESN basée à Genève, accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets informatiques grâce à ses expertises en développement applicatif, Business Intelligence et Data Management. Ses consultants interviennent aussi bien en mission directement au sein des équipes clients que dans le cadre de projets réalisés au forfait.
Sigmalis Talent Services, société sœur spécialisée dans le recrutement IT, accompagne les entreprises dans la recherche et la sélection de profils informatiques, dans le cadre de recrutements fixes ou de missions temporaires.
Cette complémentarité nous permet de conjuguer connaissance des métiers IT, expertise du recrutement et proximité avec le marché suisse romand.
### Description du poste ###
Votre mission En tant que Consultant·e en recrutement IT, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu'au suivi des candidats.

Vous intervenez aussi bien sur les recrutements destinés à renforcer les équipes de consultants du groupe que sur les mandats confiés à Sigmalis Talent Services par ses clients.

Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à identifier des CV : vous cherchez à comprendre les parcours, les compétences, les motivations et les aspirations professionnelles afin de créer des mises en relation pertinentes et durables.

Vos principales responsabilités Comprendre les besoins de recrutement, les environnements techniques et les profils recherchés, Définir et déployer les stratégies de sourcing et d'approche directe les plus adaptées, Rédiger et publier des offres d'emploi attractives et ciblées, Identifier et approcher des candidats via les différents outils, réseaux professionnels et techniques de chasse de tête, Analyser les candidatures et évaluer leur adéquation avec les exigences techniques, professionnelles et humaines du poste, Préparer et conduire des entretiens approfondis et structurés, Rédiger des comptes rendus d'entretien précis permettant de restituer les compétences, l'expérience, les motivations et les éléments déterminants de chaque candidature, Accompagner les candidats tout au long du processus et assurer un suivi régulier et professionnel, Garantir la qualité et la mise à jour des informations dans notre ATS et constituer des viviers de talents sur les profils régulièrement recherchés, Développer une relation de proximité avec les équipes internes du groupe et comprendre leurs besoins actuels et futurs, Contribuer à l'attractivité de nos opportunités et à notre marque employeu
### Profil recherché ###
Vous bénéficiez de 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans le recrutement et le sourcing de profils IT au sein d'une agence de recrutement ou d'une société de services informatiques en Suisse romande. Cette connaissance du marché local est importante pour vous permettre d'être rapidement autonome dans votre fonction.

Vous disposez également des compétences et qualités suivantes : excellente maîtrise des méthodes de sourcing, de recherche directe et de chasse de tête, bonne connaissance des principaux métiers et environnements de l'informatique, connaissance du marché de l'emploi et du tissu économique de Suisse romande, capacité à conduire des entretiens structurés et à évaluer une candidature au-delà des seuls éléments du CV, français langue maternelle ou niveau équivalent, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et une orthographe irréprochable, bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant de conduire des entretiens avec des candidats anglophones, sens de l'organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités simultanément, excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication, autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats, goût du travail en équipe et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs et métiers, respect absolu de la confidentialité et de l'éthique inhérentes au métier du recrutement.

Nous recherchons une personne qui souhaite s'investir dans la durée, développer son expertise et contribuer activement à la croissance de notre activité. Rejoindre Sigmalis Talent Services, c'est- Intégrer un groupe suisse à taille humaine, dans lequel les échanges sont directs et les responsabilités réelles.

Exercer pleinement votre métier de recruteur, de l'analyse du besoin à l'accompagnement du candidat, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité des recrutements. Évoluer au contact de spécialistes de l'IT, qui permettent de mieux comprendre les métiers, les environnements techniques et les enjeux rencontrés par nos clients.

Construire des relations de proximité avec les candidats, en privilégiant la qualité des échanges et du suivi plutôt qu'une approche purement quantitative du recrutement. Travailler sur des missions variées, aussi bien pour les besoins internes du groupe que pour des entreprises et organisations de Suisse romande.

Participer au développement d'une structure en croissance, dans laquelle vos idées, votre expérience et votre capacité à prendre des initiatives pourront directement contribuer à faire évoluer nos pratiques.

Enfin, nous accordons une importance particulière à l'éthique, la confidentialité, la qualité du travail réalisé et au respect des engagements pris envers nos candidats comme envers nos clients. Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche du recrutement et souhaitez poursuivre votre parcours dans un environnement spécialisé IT ?

Nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature et d'échanger avec vous sur votre parcours et vos aspirations professionnelles.

This is a fixed-term contract role supporting Prosci 's Talent Acquisition function across the US and Canada. The Sr. Contract Recruiter owns full life cycle recruiting for an assigned slate of open requisitions, from intake through offer, partnering closely with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to build strong candidate pipelines and a consistently positive candidate experience.
This role is intended to add recruiting capacity for a period of approximately 6 months (September 2026 – February 2027) with an anticipated workload of 20–40 hours per week; volume will vary with interview activity and open requisition load.
Since our founding in 1994, Prosci has been laser-focused on change. By combining our deep understanding of people with a proven methodology rooted in the creation of the ADKAR® model, we’ve helped countless people and organizations thrive. Our solutions empower customers with lasting change resiliency through a unique blend of training, advisory services, and licensing options, including Kaiya, our AI change management coach.
At Prosci , we are a purpose-driven organization full of passionate, curious, and results-oriented people. Working at Prosci means being part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to our purpose of creating a world where change is done right. Join us and be part of a culture that thrives on continuous learning, growth, and making a difference.
Check out our website for more about our team and approach: .

Recruiting
Manage full life cycle recruiting for assigned US and Canadian requisitions: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessment administration, reference and background checks, and offer support.
Lead intake and needs analysis conversations with hiring managers to confirm role scope, must-have criteria, and hiring timeline before opening a requisition.
Partner with HRBPs to create and publish job descriptions and postings.
Source active and passive candidates using Prosci 's ATS (Workable), LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, employee referrals, and other channels.
Conduct phone screens, coordinate interview loops, administer assessments, and lead scorecard completion and debrief discussions with interview teams.
Maintain regular, high-quality communication with candidates throughout the process to protect the candidate’s experience.
Support offer construction and, in partnership with the hiring HRBP and hiring manager, help negotiate terms with candidates.
Pipeline, Compliance, and Candidate Experience
Build and maintain candidate pipelines for roles that recur or are historically difficult to fill.
Apply sourcing, screening, and interview practices consistent with Prosci 's commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, including attention to underexplored talent pools.
Apply working knowledge of US and Canadian hiring requirements relevant to recruiting (for example, pay transparency rules, background check requirements, and state or provincial variation) and flag questions to HR Business Partners rather than making independent compliance calls.
Perform select preboarding activities for new hires from the point of offer acceptance to start date, including internal stakeholder communication, coordination of first day logistics, and scheduling of week 1 core onboarding sessions.
Reporting and Process
Keep candidate and requisition records current and accurate in the ATS (Workable).
Provide regular pipeline and hiring status updates to hiring managers and HR Business Partners.
Flag process friction or candidate experience issues to HR Business Partners and suggest improvements.

Full life cycle recruiting experience across sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer support, ideally spanning both US and Canadian hiring. Working knowledge of US and Canadian employment and hiring practices, with good judgment about when to escalate a compliance question (only US is required).
Working proficiency with an applicant tracking system and with LinkedIn Recruiter or an equivalent sourcing tool.
Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable managing multiple candidates, requisitions, and hiring manager relationships at once.
Ability to work independently against a defined requisition load with minimal day-to-day oversight.
Comfort using AI tools across the recruiting life cycle, primarily to synthesize interview notes and scorecard feedback into clear, evidence-based debrief summaries and candidate recommendations, with sound judgment about reviewing AI output for accuracy and bias before it informs a hiring decision.

5+ years of in-house or agency recruiting experience.

Prior contract or interim recruiting experience, comfortable ramping quickly on a new team's process and requisitions.
Experience with Predictive Index or a similar behavioral assessment tool.
Familiarity with competency-based, inclusive interviewing practices.

Work Location: Remote within the US or Canada.

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.
Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.
Our Talent team is looking for an experienced and discerning technical recruiter to help build Linear’s next generation of engineering talent. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who sees recruiting as a craft.
Your primary focus will be growing our engineering team in North America. You’ll work closely with engineering leadership and our existing recruiters across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and emerging technical roles. You’ll own the full search, from mapping talent markets and activating networks through assessment, work trial support, and close.
Linear engineers tend to combine technical depth with product judgment, craftsmanship, and significant ownership. Finding them requires more than matching resumes to requirements.

We’re looking for someone who can recognize these qualities, reach candidates with precision, and continually sharpen their judgment through close partnership with our team. All recruiters at Linear are generalists and may support other functions as company priorities evolve, but engineering will be the primary focus of this role.
Location & work mode
Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North American (Eastern time zone), with a strong preference for the New York City area.

Being in New York enables closer partnership with our growing local team, candidate events, and optional in-person support during work trials. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

The Technical Recruiter at AxisCare will develop and run full-cycle recruiting for our technical roles across our Software Engineering, QA, and Product Management departments. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build a technical hiring engine at a rapidly growing SaaS company.

Develop and run full-cycle recruiting for software engineering, QA, and other R&D roles, from intake through offer negotiation and close.
Partner directly with engineering managers and directors to scope roles, calibrate technical interview bars, and build realistic hiring plans against the R&D roadmap.
Proactively source passive technical candidates using Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub/Stack Overflow, and technical communities, rather than relying primarily on inbound applicants.
Design and run technical screening processes in partnership with hiring managers, including structuring interview loops and calibrating panel feedback.
Manage a high volume of concurrent technical reqs across levels (IC through senior) without sacrificing candidate experience.
Track pipeline health, time-to-fill, and funnel conversion for R identify bottlenecks and recommend process changes.
Share technical sourcing techniques and market intelligence with the broader recruiting team to raise the bar company-wide.
Represent AxisCare's engineering culture in the technical talent market, including at relevant meetups, communities, or events as needed.

4+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience (in-house or agency), with a track record of hiring software engineers.
Demonstrated, hands-on experience proactively sourcing passive technical candidates, not just managing inbound pipeline.
Working fluency in engineering roles and stacks sufficient to screen credibly for technical fit (e.g., backend vs. frontend vs. full-stack, QA, DevOps) and hold informed conversations with candidates and hiring managers.
Experience partnering with engineering leadership to build hiring plans and calibrate interview panels.
Strong fluency with sourcing and ATS tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub/Stack Overflow sourcing, applicant tracking systems).
Excellent candidate experience, offer negotiation, and closing skills.
Comfortable managing a high volume of concurrent reqs across multiple levels and role types.

Recruiting experience in healthtech, SaaS, or a high-growth startup environment.
Experience recruiting for QA and technical product roles in addition to core engineering.
Experience reporting recruiting metrics and pipeline health directly to leadership.
Working Conditions
Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals
Utilization of phone, other software needed/required and email to perform job functions

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.
AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user-friendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more.

Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment. ## Office des travaux publics | 80-100 % | Splügen ##
L'Office des travaux publics est responsable de la planification, de la construction, de l'entretien et de l'exploitation des routes cantonales ainsi que des ouvrages hydrauliques et de la mobilité douce dans les Grisons. Nous nous occupons également de l'entretien opérationnel des routes nationales sur le territoire cantonal.

L'infrastructure routière du canton comprend plus de 1'450 ouvrages d'art, dont des ponts suspendus jusqu'à 90 mètres de hauteur et des tunnels pouvant atteindre 3 kilomètres de longueur. Les défis que la nature de notre canton montagneux présente en été comme en hiver rendent notre travail exigeant et varié.

En tant qu'office certifié Friendly Work Space, la santé et la satisfaction de nos quelque 480 collaborateurs nous tiennent particulièrement à cœur. C'est pourquoi nous nous engageons pour une gestion systématique de la santé en entreprise (GSE).

* Contrôle de l'état des routes et des installations routières
* Assurer le service de permanence (été et hiver)

* Habileté manuelle

TMR traverse une phase de structuration et de modernisation de safonction RH. Les fondations de la politique RH sont posées ; il reste désormais à bâtir et industrialiser l'essentiel des processus qui structureront durablement la fonction pour nos quelque 240 collaborateurs.
Concrètement, plusieurs chantiers avancent en parallèle : déploiement d'un nouveau SIRH et de ses workflows (recrutement, entrée, sortie, signature électronique), construction d'une architecture des emplois, digitalisation du cycle de vie collaborateur, pilotage prévisionnel de la masse salariale et gestion prévisionnelle des effectifs et des compétences (GPEC).

C'est un moment rare où presque tout est à concevoir, à outiller et à ancrer dans les usages - et où votre contribution aura un impact direct, concret et visible.
Dans cecontexte, nous recherchons un·e Partenaire RH qui aime autant accompagner les équipes au quotidien que construire les processus et les outils qui feront la maturité de demain. Die iPersonal AG ist ein Temporärbüro, das sich auf die Vermittlung von qualifizierten Fachkräften spezialisiert hat und Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, passgenaue personelle Lösungen zu finden.
**Über uns:**
Die iPersonal AG ist ein dynamisch wachsendes Unternehmen in der Schweizer Personalberatungsbranche, das durch sein innovatives Geschäftsmodell und modernste Ansätze im Recruiting neue Maßstäbe setzt. Mit einem topmodernen Büro im Herzen von Zürich und einer klaren Vision für nachhaltige Personalstrategien bieten wir Ihnen einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem Sie Ihre Expertise einbringen, erweitern und Ihren eigenen Stil entfalten können.
**Ihre Verantwortung:**
* Als Senior Personalberater/in betreuen Sie anspruchsvolle Rekrutierungsmandate für Fach- und Führungspositionen im Bauhaupt- und Baunebengewerbe, sowie branchenübergreifend für KMUs und Großunternehmen.
* Sie übernehmen die volle Prozessverantwortung - von der detaillierten Analyse des Personalbedarfs, über die gezielte Direktansprache und persönliche Interviews bis hin zur erfolgreichen Vertragsunterzeichnung.
* Mit Ihrem Gespür für Marktentwicklungen und Branchentrends beraten Sie Kunden proaktiv, entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Recruiting-Strategien und etablieren sich als vertrauenswürdige/r Ansprechpartner/in auf Augenhöhe.
* Sie pflegen und erweitern Ihr eigenes Netzwerk an Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, nutzen kreative Sourcing-Methoden und setzen auf innovative Tools, um schnell und effizient Top-Talente zu identifizieren.
* Ihre Rolle umfasst zudem die Unterstützung beim Auf- und Ausbau unserer Markenbekanntheit, indem Sie sich intern und extern als Thought Leader positionieren, Ideen einbringen und unsere Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten.
**Ihr Profil:**
* Mehrjährige, fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Personalberatung, idealerweise mit dem Schwerpunkt auf anspruchsvolle Fach- und Führungspositionen im Schweizer Markt.
* Ausgeprägtes Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsgeschick, gepaart mit souveränem Auftreten und Freude am Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Kundinnen und Kunden.
* Affinität zu digitalen Rekrutierungsmethoden, Kreativität im Active Sourcing und ein innovationsgetriebener Blick auf den Personalmarkt.
* Unternehmerisches Denken, Eigeninitiative sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein in Bezug auf Kunden- und Kandidatenerlebnisse.
* Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
**Wir bieten:**
* Eine unbefristete Anstellung (100%) in einem zukunftsorientierten, wachsenden Unternehmen mit klarem Fokus auf Modernität und Weiterentwicklung.
* Ein hochmodernes Büro in Zürich und der Einsatz von neuesten Recruiting-Technologien, um Ihnen optimale Rahmenbedingungen für Ihren Erfolg zu bieten.
* Sehr attraktive, leistungsorientierte Vergütungsmodelle und erfolgsabhängige Bonusregelungen, die Ihren Einsatz fair belohnen.
* Umfangreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie ein unterstützendes, dynamisches Team, in dem Ihre Expertise geschätzt und Ihre Ideen gehört werden.

Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) 80-100%
* Full-time
Company Description
Wüest Partner is an innovative and independent software and service company in the real estate industry. Since 1985, we have been creating sound decision-making foundations by combining real estate expertise, data, and digital solutions. As an industry leader, we shape the future of the real estate sector together with our clients - offering comprehensive services in valuation, consulting, data, analytics, AI, software, sustainability, and education.
The Wüest Partner Group employs around 500 people at 15 locations across Europe, with its headquarters in Switzerland. The group includes the subsidiaries Durable, Datahouse, Qualicasa, and Signa-Terre.
Job Description
Your Team & Mission
Recruiting is much more to us than just filling open positions - it is a crucial success factor for our growth. As part of our Human Resources Department, you will become a member of our Talent Acquisition & Development team and be responsible for operational recruiting in Switzerland and our international locations. You will work closely with our managers, HR business partners, and HR services, actively shaping recruitment success.
Together, we create a positive employee experience - from attracting new talent to developing our employees. With your experience, entrepreneurial thinking, and advisory skills, you ensure that we attract the right talent even in a dynamic environment.
Due to an upcoming maternity leave in our team, we are now looking for reinforcement and look forward to an experienced individual who will help us further develop Talent Acquisition and contribute to the future expansion of our department.
Your Tasks
* You are responsible for the entire recruiting process (end-to-end) for positions in Switzerland as well as at our international locations.
* You advise and coach hiring managers as a competent sparring partner and support them in making well-founded recruitment decisions, ensuring a smooth recruiting process.
* You develop targeted search strategies together with the specialist departments and implement them independently.
* You actively identify and approach suitable talents via various channels (active sourcing).
* You ensure an excellent candidate experience and professionally accompany candidates throughout the entire application process.
* You collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and manage to advise and convince in a solution-oriented manner even in challenging situations.
* You analyse recruiting metrics, identify optimisation potentials, and contribute ideas for the continuous development of our recruiting processes and employer branding activities.

Your Profile
* At least five years of experience in in-house talent acquisition as well as experience recruiting for Switzerland and ideally for international locations.
* Completed studies (FH/university) or comparable education and training with a focus on human resources, business administration, or psychology.
* Active sourcing is second nature to you, and you use modern recruiting methods purposefully.
* You bring strong advisory skills and manage to professionally coach or challenge hiring managers and navigate confidently in a diverse stakeholder environment.
* You work independently, prioritise confidently, and take responsibility for your topics.
* You think entrepreneurially, recognise opportunities, and implement pragmatic solutions.
* Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken.
Additional Information

* Attractive employment conditions with a variable compensation component
* Flexible Work Smart concept with home office option
* Refreshing, professional, and collegial corporate culture with great events (company celebrations, croissant breaks, etc.)
* High team spirit, flat hierarchies, and varied tasks
* Beautiful workplace in the centre of Zurich with modern infrastructure
* Generous training budget including time for it as well as other attractive fringe benefits
Contact
If you have any questions, Federica Arcella, Lead Talent Acquisition Coordinator & Development, will be happy to assist you at talentacquisition@wuestpartner.com.
For recruitment agencies: Only direct applications will be considered.
For data protection reasons, applications can only be accepted online.
We look forward to hearing from you!

s.h: How you will make an impact
s.t:
As a Technical Recruiter in Portugal, you'll be part of a global Talent Acquisition team and an ongoing Lisbon presence. You will hire across technical and non-technical disciplines - sourcing and engaging candidates, guiding them through our hiring process, and owning a candidate experience that reflects who we are as a company.
This role is ideal for someone early in their recruiting career who is genuinely curious about technology and who wants to learn how a high-performing engineering organization is built. You won't just execute a process: you'll be expected to understand the "why" behind every role, raise the bar on how we work, and build real, lasting relationships with the people we hire (and the ones we don't).
One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply, as we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond the job description. Note: Please kindly submit your resume in English. Thank you!

s.h: How you will make a difference
s.t:
Support and progressively own full-cycle recruitment across multiple roles as we grow our Lisbon team
Deliver a top-class candidate experience at every touchpoint - build genuine, lasting relationships, understand what drives each person, and make every interaction reflect who Iterable is
Partner with hiring managers to understand each role deeply - the tech stack, the team, the "why" - and use that knowledge to engage and evaluate candidates more effectively
Bring a technologist mindset to everything you do: actively explore AI tools, test new approaches, and find smarter ways to work across sourcing, outreach, and day-to-day recruiting
Support TA operations - maintaining templates, coordinating scheduling, and keeping our ATS up to date - ensuring the foundations are always in place for a seamless hiring process
Start building your presence in the local tech community - representing Iterable at events, growing your network, and nurturing candidate relationships over time

1–3 years of experience in recruiting, sourcing, or a talent-adjacent role
A genuine interest in technology: you can hold a credible conversation about how software teams work, and you actively follow tech and AI trends
Strong will to explore new AI technology hands-on — you dive into new tools rather than waiting to be trained on them
Real drive and ambition: you want to improve your work, raise standards, and deliver with genuine care
Curious to understand the "why" behind roles, decisions, and processes
An obsession with human connection and candidate experience - you believe recruiting is fundamentally a people job
Strong written and verbal communication skills
A confident, coachable, and enthusiastic mindset - you thrive on feedback and in a fast-moving environment
Fluency in written and verbal English

Experience sourcing for technical/engineering roles

You'll work closely with Recruiting, People Business Partners, and Engineering leadership to understand what the Vancouver team needs to scale well, then build the programs, systems, and relationships to make it happen. Own full-cycle talent acquisition for the Vancouver site. Partner with Engineering leadership to define hiring strategy, recruit for senior and niche technical roles, build local talent pipelines, and support workforce planning as the team scales.

Serve as the trusted go-to for Vancouver employees: fielding questions, navigating sensitive situations, and connecting people to the right resources across People, Legal, Immigration, and Finance.

8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with depth in technical domains (Engineering, Gaming, Rendering/Graphics, AI/ML, etc.)
Demonstrated success hiring senior and niche technical talent in competitive markets
A strong track record of influencing stakeholders and solving complex recruiting challenges with creativity and innovation
A data-driven approach with the ability to analyze metrics, surface insights, and inform strategy
Experience building people programs and systems from the ground up, with outcomes you can speak to
A startup mentality and openness to thinking outside the box
Excitement about being on-site full-time in Vancouver: you believe in-person presence matters and you show up with energy.

Strategically minded: you can zoom out to understand what a site needs to grow well, then zoom in to execute the detailed work that makes it happen.
A connector: you build trust quickly with employees and cross-functional partners at all levels, and you know how to get things done through influence rather than authority.
Data-informed: you use signals, survey results, retention trends, anecdotal feedback to shape priorities and make the case for investment.
Proactive, not reactive: you anticipate what the office and employees need before problems surface, and you move fast when they do.

s.h: TALENT ACQUISITION PARTNER II / SENIOR - CONTRACT
s.t:
Based onsite at Rocket Lab’s Middle River, MD facility, the Talent Acquisition Partner is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with hiring managers and candidates alike to fill highly critical roles.
This is a full life-cycle recruitment position – you will own everything from initial sourcing and screening to extending offers. As a member of the TA team, you will be integral in fulfilling our mission to open up access to space to improve life on earth by hiring innovators who will help shape our rapidly expanding programs.
*This is a 6-month fixed-term role for immediate hire, with the potential opportunity to convert to full-time employment upon term completion. This role sits onsite at our Middle River, MD facility – remote work is not considered for this position.*

Serve as a strategic hiring expert and partner to hiring managers and business unit leaders
Partner with hiring managers to determine the requirements and expectations for their open positions, and the qualities of their ideal candidate
Manage the full hiring life-cycle, from initial sourcing and screening to extending offers
Screen candidates for open roles and guide them through the interview process
Build a diverse pipeline of talent, including passive candidates, through sourcing, cold calling, phone screens, and networking
Utilize our ATS (Greenhouse) to build reports and analyze key metrics on recruiting activities to drive process improvements
Travel as needed to support hiring efforts at other sites, including Launch Complex 3 in Wallops Island VA and Space Structures Complex in Middle River, MD

How we think about talent
At Euc, talent is the growth engine behind everything we do. We are not here to fill roles or keep pipelines warm. We go where candidates are, earn their attention, and create a hiring experience that converts.
We move fast. Really fast. Because the best people don’t stay on the market for long, and neither do we.

Sourcing is king. The best engineers, product leaders, and technical minds are not applying; they are found. We go outbound, get creative, and meet technical talent where they live (GitHub, open-source communities, and technical events).
Process mastery. Hiring at pace creates friction. We spot bottlenecks in code assessments and interview loops early, clearing the path before they slow the team down.
The recruiting funnel is a sales funnel. Drop-off is a signal. We track it, understand it, and fix it. Every stage is a chance to win or lose exceptional technical talent.
Curiosity drives better outcomes. New tools, new tactics, and new ideas. If something might work, we test it. Better technical hiring comes from constantly evolving our approach.

About Kojo
It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.
Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

To meet our season of record-breaking customer growth and AI product innovation, we’re bringing on a Recruiting Lead to own the recruiting function end to end. Primarily in the GTM/G&A realms, entry-level to senior leadership searches will fall under this recruiter’s purview - plus the recruiting operations that keep the machine running behind the scenes.
In a talent landscape that’s ever-evolving and increasingly competitive, a best in class recruiting function is more important than ever. Our hiring methodology isn’t sheer volume, but sincere business partnership and quality of hire.

You’ll work with hiring managers as an extension of their team and manage the operations and scalability to maintain best in class hiring amid global expansion. As a Series C company growing at this record-breaking pace, every hire you make has an outsized impact on what Kojo becomes next.

There's no more pivotal time to join and help us take Kojo further into the candidate market.

Own full-cycle recruiting for Kojo 's GTM and G&A searches, from intake to offer, across levels from entry-level to senior leadership.
Actively source best-in-class candidates, both active and passive, and ensure a white glove candidate experience through consultative, timely communication and market intelligence to properly matchmake between open roles at Kojo .
Manage, iterate, and continue to run the operating rhythm behind recruiting: profile debriefs and ICP iterations, pipeline reviews, and the reporting cadence that keeps hiring managers and leadership aligned on where every search stands.
Manage Ashby as Kojo 's ATS and single source of truth for headcount budgeting, owning requisition workflows, scorecards, and the data hygiene that makes every pipeline report trustworthy.
Own compensation benchmarking for open reqs, partnering with our Director of People on real-time GTM and G&A market data instead of last year's numbers.
Continuously close candidates through every stage in the hiring process to ensure a best in class offer acceptance rate, and manage the offer for every close, partnering directly with Finance on budget and approval before it goes out.
Diagnose where the recruiting process itself is the bottleneck, time-to-fill, drop-off stage, interviewer load, and fix it before it becomes a leadership question.
Leverage AI-enabled workflows and internal tools (e.g., Claude, Granola, Notion, LinkedIn Recruiter) to understand market signals at scale by synthesizing feedback, hiring patterns, and requests to identify opportunities before they become obvious.

We’re looking for the recruiter who treats every search as the chance to bring exceptional talent and outsized impact to Kojo . Our ideal Lead Recruiter is a student of the market: constantly building a genuine knowledge base of the ever-changing talent landscape in AI and construction, and knowing where the best talent sits today and what it takes to get them excited about Kojo .
Early stage experience is strongly preferred in this environment. Priorities shift, searches evolve, and there’s a sincere opportunity to scale far beyond the bounds of this job description. We’re looking for someone who wants to build with the company and may be operating as an individual contributor today, but has the curiosity to scale into broader leadership roles as we continue to grow.

Full-cycle ownership: You've run searches start to finish, from intake call to signed offer (and hopefully hiring high-slope talent where those candidates become long-term employees), without needing a coordinator to hold your hand through any stage.
GTM fluency: You know the difference between what makes a great SDR and what makes a great enterprise AE, and you screen for it accordingly (deep GTM specialization is ideal, not required for every search).
Early-stage instinct: "You've recruited inside a company early enough in its growth that you were also inventing and iterating upon the process, not just following one.
Ops discipline: You treat your ATS as a system of record and have demonstrated experience trusting that data and partnering with Operations and Finance stakeholders to allow your data to inform business decisions.
Independent operation: You have strong judgement to know what’s urgent, what’s important, and where your time and energy should go in order to best serve the business in real time. You have experience pattern matching not only with candidate themes, but consistently upleveling the internal recruiting function from the inside out.
AI-literate sourcing: You've used AI tools to speed up sourcing or screening, and you can point to a specific moment you overrode the tool's judgment with your own.
Range across levels: You've closed both an entry-level hire and a senior leadership hire in the same quarter, and you didn't treat either one as the easy one.

ACCOUNTABILITY: You own the calibration call between a hiring manager who wants faster and a comp band that isn't moving, and you make the trade-off explicit instead of quietly splitting the difference.
IMPACT: You're running searches at three different levels at once, and you always know which one earns the next hour of your day.
GROWTH: You read the market data before you defend a comp number, not after a candidate pushes back on it.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Emerging Talent is an important part of how Ramp builds for the long term. It gives us the opportunity to meet exceptional people early, build relationships before they enter the broader talent market, and develop the next generation of Ramp talent.

We're looking for a Sr. Recruiter to be the driving force behind hiring the technical talent that powers our go-to-market engine across Singapore (Asean/Greater China Region) — Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the broader Field Engineering org.

These are the people who sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers, turn the world's hardest data and AI problems into production reality, and make Databricks impossible to compete against. Your job is to find them, win them, and close them.
This is an exciting time to be part of the rocketship and the Databricks expansion in India. We're scaling fast, the bar is high, and the demand for elite technical pre-sales and field talent has never been more intense. You'll own full-cycle hiring for some of the most sought-after profiles in the market, partnering directly with Field Engineering leadership to build teams that don't yet exist.
Recruiters at Databricks are subject matter experts when it comes to talent attraction and are given full autonomy to bring new ideas and creative approaches to life. If you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and get energy from building in a high-growth, high-pressure environment, read on.

Own full-cycle recruiting for technical GTM roles across Singapore (Asean/Greater China Region) — Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Field Engineering leadership — from first outreach to close.
Partner with Field Engineering and Sales leaders as a true strategic advisor on sourcing strategy, market mapping, competitive intelligence, comp positioning, and talent insights.
Activate and engage passive, hard-to-reach technical talent — the builders and problem-solvers who aren't actively looking but are exactly who we need.
Build and sustain engaged talent pipelines that can keep pace with aggressive hiring goals and our continued APJ expansion.
Create closing strategies that win against the most competitive offers in the market and manage stakeholder expectations with data.
Use data to set benchmarks and metrics, drive workforce planning, and continuously sharpen our hiring process as we scale.
Champion a world-class candidate experience and act as a brand ambassador for Databricks at every touchpoint.
Play a key role in building a diverse, inclusive, and exceptionally high-caliber workforce.

Proven experience recruiting within the software / Data / AI industry, ideally for technical GTM, pre-sales, Solutions Architecture, or Field Engineering profiles.
A track record of scaling teams at a high-growth company — you know what it takes to hire fast without dropping the bar.
High energy, grit, and a relentless work ethic — you get stuff done and you don't wait to be told how.
An "AI builder" mindset: genuinely curious about the technology, hands-on with new tools, and able to speak credibly to deeply technical candidates.
Comfort with chaos — you stay calm, prioritize ruthlessly, and thrive when the goalposts move and the pressure is on.
The ability to build strategic partnerships across the business and influence senior stakeholders with data and conviction.
A creative, resourceful approach to sourcing — you don't rely on the obvious channels and you love finding talent others can't.
Strong ownership and a bias for action; you treat your reqs like they're your own business.

We're looking for someone who brings a blend of executive search agency rigor and in-house recruiting fluency, ideally with experience in the technology industry.
This role will be based out of our New York City office with a hybrid working model.

Own end-to-end executive search processes for VP+ level roles, from intake through offer and close
Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring executives and the leadership team, shaping search strategy, candidate profiles, and market mapping
Build and manage a proactive pipeline of senior leadership talent through direct sourcing, market research, and a strong external network

Manage complex, multi-stakeholder search processes with discretion, precision, and executive presence
Partner with People teams on compensation strategy, offer construction, and negotiation for senior hires
Represent MongoDB's employer brand and leadership hiring standards in every candidate and stakeholder interaction
Continuously sharpen executive hiring processes, tools, and market intelligence to keep MongoDB competitive for top leadership talent

Deep experience partnering with and influencing senior executives and stakeholders

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

To further this important mission, we are building the foundation for a long-term talent bench at Stripe. We believe every campus hire can build products with meaningful impact at Stripe, and provide a far-reaching impact for anyone trying to grow their business online. We are looking for a University Recruiter to join our team to attract and hire the very best junior talent, while providing each candidate with an exceptional experience. This is a 11 month fixed term contract.

We’re a small but mighty team, and are committed to big results.

You will help shape the future of our early-stage programs and be responsible for all parts of the campus recruiting life cycle, including, but not limited to, organizing and leading on campus events, driving a strong and diverse candidate pipeline, branding, building relationships with internal stakeholders, and managing our global internship program.

You must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment - unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes.

Partner closely with Stripe’s engineering organization to build the foundation of our early-stage university program
Manage the full-cycle recruiting process for new graduate and intern candidates across multiple roles and offices
Develop deep relationships with university groups, including faculty and student organizations, to design school-specific strategies that enhance our value proposition and brand on campus
Plan and execute on campus events with a focus on early engagement, education, and strategic branding
Screen candidates and ensure that our hiring process is consistent and inclusive
Drive a positive candidate experience for every new graduate and intern candidate considering a career at Stripe
Build and iterate on our year-round internship program alongside teammates and cross-functional stakeholders
Act as a resource to interns from hire to full-time conversion
Proactively share data-centric updates with internal stakeholders to maintain aligned decision making and build trusted partnerships
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

A minimum of 5+ years full-cycle university recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
A passion for building teams and delivering exceptional candidate experienceExcellent verbal and written communication skills, with an appropriate blend of professionalism and friendliness
Proven abilities to create a strategic campus strategy and build a diverse pipeline
An active and data-driven approach to problem solving; you may enjoy making sense of the trends and using the insights to better your process to make it more efficient
A growth mindset and truly flexible. You can shift tasks and priorities with circumstances change (At a fast-growing startup, they often do)
An interest in working in a cross-functional and fluid environment, the ability to learn quickly, and no desire to take yourself too seriously (a wry sense of humor is always appreciated!)
Ability and willingness to travel up to 30% during peak recruiting cycles and work flexible hours as needed
